floor_rule: if the primary metric is exactly 0.0 in BOTH arms on EVERY cell, the verdict is unmeasurable_instrument_floor -- an instrument that cannot vary has not measured a null
generator: Qwen3.5-9B-MTP GGUF (operator-directed: NOT the 31B, whose 21GB on a 24GB card is the documented cause of the 2026-07-24 wedge)
min_reachable_two_sided_p_formula: 2 * 0.5**n_discordant, capped at 1.0; 1.0 when n_discordant == 0 (no test possible)
primary_metric: held-out exact-full-grid accuracy (WorldModelVerifier.accuracy on the PROMPT-COMPLEMENT transitions), averaged per game over replicates
primary_test: two-sided exact sign test on per-game paired deltas; ties dropped
prior_data_point: one Qwen-9B tu93 induce, heldout 0.000 for BOTH arms (ops/verifier_gaps.md 2026-07-24; explicitly not an A/B)
secondary_metrics: full-window accuracy (the exp5831 quantity, for continuity)
secondary_test: exact sign-flip permutation test on the same per-game deltas
train_only_stratum_reason: window has <= 6 transitions so the prompt shows ALL of them; any accuracy on these games is TRAINING accuracy and is reported separately, never as heldout
